scripts.build-dev: npm run build-wasm && vite build --mode development
scripts.build-wasm: RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+bulk-memory,+sign-ext' cargo build --release --manifest-path src/rs/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --no-typescript --out-dir ./src/rs/pkg ./src/rs/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/etg.wasm
scripts.build-wasm-debug: RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+bulk-memory,+sign-ext' cargo build --manifest-path src/rs/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --no-typescript --out-dir ./src/rs/pkg ./src/rs/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/etg.wasm
